findings.description: Observed accounting does not observe the existing temporal or warrant consumers. It executes the same Expansion traversal against an import-time copy of the declarations, then separately calls the real preparer and retains only its diagnostics. In isolated direct and SQLite-reader probes, bypassing the temporal consumer's Evidence.coverage boundary read with a literal 'interval' returned diagnostics=(), successful support, and an unchanged observed ledger. The new missing/extra-read controls mutate role.Access, so they do not detect this disconnect.

History expansion resolves an exact row but discards the returned record without expanding its required operands. An E5 hypothesis audit therefore checks the current confidence and the predecessor's identity, but never the predecessor confidence needed by the upward-revision prerequisite. Direct and SQLite-reader probes returned empty diagnostics and successful full role-profile support when predecessor confidence was missing, null or a string. No predecessor field appeared in expected obligations. The same structural omission applies to original PilotClip operands. This concerns prerequisite access, not deferred history-head selection or final predicates.

Checked applicability does not preserve existing valid optional branches. There is no derivative activation rule based on PilotSubmission.frame_indices, so the generic fallback treats an explicitly null derivative as unavailable even when checked frame_indices is empty. On both isolated adapters, the unchanged temporal preparer accepted this valid no-attachment submission with no diagnostics, while the new audit emitted UNKNOWN/null required field for derivative and denied support. The new preserved-root controls exercise only the attachment-present fixture.

Scope membership checks only a subset of required links for roots spanning media and intent. EvidenceArm and InstrumentRun are classified solely through evidence.media; their plan.competing_set.intent is never compared with the checked intent. In direct and SQLite-reader probes, an EvidenceArm whose evidence matched the selected media but whose pinned plan belonged to another intent returned active membership with only a media justification. Missing or damaged plan-scope evidence likewise cannot affect this membership decision.

Scoped preparation discards the accounting foundation it computes. For each active root it preserves only audit diagnostics, dropping expected, observed and checked_inactive. Its returned Receipt consequently always has empty accounting ledgers and no declaration-level inactive obligations; applicability records only rule/root membership. Independent probes confirmed ACTIVE rules with expected=(), observed=() and checked_inactive=(). The unconditional semantic UNKNOWN correctly prevents completion, but does not satisfy the required auditable prerequisite receipt.

Computed-output coverage is not deletion-sensitive. The tests require valid operands and some support, but do not assert that Evidence.digest or TestPlan.authored was computed, passed through its output boundary, or discharged a computed obligation. I removed the entire computed loop in an in-memory source mutation: all 83 parameterized computed operand/nested controls still passed for each isolated adapter. Both ledgers silently lose the same obligation because they share this implementation. The existing inventory equality tests cannot detect that missing execution.
